title: Arithmetic correctness of decrement
statement: For every Boolean word $u$, if the fixed-width decrement succeeds, the value of its resulting word plus one equals the value of $u$; if it fails, the value of $u$ is zero.
replaced: For every binary word $u$: if the fixed-width decrement of $u$ succeeds, the value of the resulting word plus one equals the value of $u$; if it fails, the value of $u$ is zero.
